items: EU adds €2 per-line handling fee. From 1 November, distance-sales shipments arriving from outside the EU face the fee for each line, not each parcel. Product Identifier data is requested on all shipments from 26 October, and the fee follows the €3 charge on low-value goods that began 1 July.

USPS rule shifts customs charges to mailers. An interim final rule effective October 19 requires mailers to use a delivered duty paid basis where the destination country requires it. USPS may invoice mailers for duties, taxes and fees not paid in full through its DDP service, and comments are due November 18.

USPS slows Ground Advantage to Hawaii, Alaska. Since Oct. 1, Ground Advantage delivery expectations for noncontiguous destinations, including Puerto Rico, are 10 days or more, with packages under one pound moving mainly by surface. USPS says prices are unchanged, and Priority Mail to Hawaii is listed at 2 to 4 business days.
